subject: Private Offer: NimbleHealth — approver roster, 18-month term & evidence request
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer: NimbleHealth — initial term/pricing proposal

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m attaching a first-pass private offer package for NimbleHealth so your procurement and legal teams can review. High-level options we discussed: 

- 12 month, no commit (pay-as-you-go): list pricing
- 12 month, $500k commit: 8% off list + reserved capacity SLA
- 18 month, $1.2M commit: 15% off list + 99.9% latency SLA and a co-sell marketing credit

If NimbleHealth is leaning toward the 18-month structure, we’ll need a short approver roster from your procurement/legal side (name, title, email) and any internal PO/DocuSign process notes so we can pre-seed the DocuSign packet. Also attaching a SOC2 summary and an editable PO template for convenience.

Can you share the approver list and target effective date? I can loop in our legal ops and market place team to accelerate the private offer creation once we have that.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nimble_PO_Redwood_v1.docx, SOC2-Summary-2026.pdf

From: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@nimblehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: NimbleHealth — initial term/pricing proposal

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. NimbleHealth is interested in exploring the 18-month committed option — the 15% discount aligns with our internal targets if we can get predictable latency and a 3-month ramp credit.

Approver roster (preliminary):
- Maya Santos, Sr. Counsel, mayas@nimblehealth.com
- Peter Lowe, VP Procurement, plowe@nimblehealth.com
- Procurement Group, procurement@nimblehealth.com

Procurement process notes: we prefer a single PO with a DocuSign signature that both Legal and Procurement countersign. We will need SOC2 artifact summary and a short data retention statement for review by Legal.

Can Karthik or Ben confirm whether a 3-month ramp credit is feasible and whether the 15% applies to the committed portion only or to overall usage?

Regards,
Alex
Alex Dunne
Head of Partnerships, NimbleHealth
Attachments: (none)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: NimbleHealth — initial term/pricing proposal

Sofia / team —

Quick internal note on economics: 18mo / $1.2M commit + 15% off looks doable if the discount applies to committed spend first with overage billed at list (we can also offer blended effective discount if they guarantee a minimum monthly drawdown threshold). For the 3-month ramp credit request, propose: apply a one-time $60k credit to their first quarter invoices (effectively ~5% of commit) to help the ramp. That keeps net economics within our forecast.

Operational asks: we’ll need SOC2 summary (attached) and a short DPA excerpt for their legal counsel. Also flag to Marketplace ops that Nimble wants a single DocuSign PO and prefers AWS Private Offer flow (no marketplace procurement intermediary).

I’ll attach a draft PO with the proposed credit line for Sofia to send to Alex.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nimble_PO_Redwood_v1.docx

From: NimbleHealth Procurement <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Santos <m.santos@nimblehealth.com>, Peter Lowe <plowe@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: NimbleHealth — approver roster & evidence request

Sofia / Vanessa —

Thanks for the proposal. Procurement prefers the 18-month, committed model with the 3-month ramp credit you suggested. Before we proceed to DocuSign we have two asks from Legal: 

1) Please provide a SOC2 attestation summary (not the full report) and a short statement on data retention and deletion timelines for customer data processed by Redwood.
2) We redlined the PO template with a few standard clauses (see attached nimble_redlines.docx). The key commercial items are OK, but Legal requires the indemnity paragraph to reflect mutual indemnification and a 60‑day notice for changes to service levels.

If you can accept those redlines or propose alternative language, we can circulate the DocuSign packet to our two approvers (Maya and Peter) and route to signature.

Best,
Procurement Team
procurement@nimblehealth.com
Attachments: nimble_redlines.docx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private Offer: NimbleHealth — approver roster & evidence request

Team — forwarding procurement’s redlines and next steps. I reviewed Nimble’s changes and propose we accept the mutual indemnity language with a minor modification to the service-level notice clause: counter-propose 90 days for material changes (our product ops team requires longer notice for infra changes that affect latency). Karthik: please confirm this keeps the economics intact — if we extend to 90 days we should preserve the 15% discount and the $60k ramp credit.

I’ve prepared the DocuSign packet and pre-filled the approver emails. Once we agree on the 90-day notice language I’ll update the PO, upload the redline response, and send the DocuSign link to procurement.

DocuSign link (pre-seed): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/98765

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
